cards.authoringBoundary: The V9 document is authoritative; Authoring Inventory is derived and V8 is import-only.
cards.label: Course Project V9
limitations: V1-V7 are not reopened by the current V9 path.
cards.purpose: Persist an editable multi-surface course with stable identities and explicit V8 migration.

cards.authoringBoundary: Prefer Native for stable content; all items participate in the unified layer order.
cards.label: Native editable elements
cards.purpose: Author stable text, formula, image, video, shape and teacher-controller content.

cards.authoringBoundary: Layer order is explicit; underlay and overlay are not public V9 authoring layers.
cards.label: Slide surface
limitations: The slide canvas is fixed at 1280×720.
cards.purpose: Compose fixed 1280×720 scenes with Native, Runtime and Component items in one ordered layer model.

cards.authoringBoundary: Block IDs remain stable across reorder, save and export; in-place text editing commits one history entry per submission.
cards.label: Flow document surface
limitations: DOCX maps semantics and does not preserve browser-only interaction.
cards.purpose: Author semantic long-form blocks with headings, paragraphs, lists, media, tables, formulas and embedded components.

cards.authoringBoundary: World items use stable layer identities; camera frames are explicit authoring data.
cards.label: Spatial 2D surface
limitations: This is a 2D surface, not a general 3D scene editor.
cards.purpose: Explore a two-dimensional world through camera poses, frames and semantic zoom.

cards.authoringBoundary: Locations reference existing surfaces and optional scene, block or camera-frame anchors.
cards.label: Mixed course navigation
cards.purpose: Navigate across Slide, Flow and Spatial 2D locations while keeping shared course state.

cards.authoringBoundary: Visible text must and ordinary replaceable images should expose stable targets; keep source out of giant build strings.
cards.label: Runtime module
limitations: Use only when Native behavior is insufficient.
cards.purpose: Implement a one-off complex dynamic mechanism as an ordinary source module.

cards.authoringBoundary: Choose Component only for real cross-course reuse; edit only declared props and target bindings.
cards.label: Component API 4
limitations: Package admission and licensing remain separate product checks.
cards.purpose: Embed a versioned reusable interactive capability with declared props, events and authoring targets.

cards.authoringBoundary: Playback state is session data unless an author explicitly persists a named state.
cards.label: Declarative course state and navigation guards
limitations: No arbitrary JavaScript expressions in conditions or actions.
cards.purpose: Track finite typed state, checkpoints, attempts, guarded navigation and restart without arbitrary expressions.

cards.authoringBoundary: Reserved interface: no editor UI applies patches in the current version; the persisted address and current revision identify a machine-applied edit.
cards.label: Stable authoring address patch
limitations: A stale revision is rejected and must be reread.
No editor UI applies patches; only unmounted preflight interfaces and the closed-project disk CLI.
cards.purpose: Patch one selected text, asset or property without regenerating the course or overwriting later edits.

cards.authoringBoundary: Published output is one-way delivery data and is not an editable project.
cards.label: Published Course V2 web output
limitations: Browser-delivered executable code is not DRM.
cards.purpose: Compile Course Project V9 into a player-only payload, standalone offline HTML or web package.

cards.authoringBoundary: Report preserved, static, fallback and omitted behavior instead of implying interaction survives.
cards.label: Surface-aware static exports
limitations: PPTX is a static Slide compatibility output; Flow and Spatial semantics are not converted into editable slide layouts.
The main editor PDF export path does not pass Slide capture hooks yet (Z1 check); Slide pages may be missing from a real PDF until that is verified or fixed.
cards.purpose: Produce Flow DOCX, semantic paged HTML/PDF input, Spatial overview/frame pages and a Mixed difference report.
